# PDF.js

Vendored from Mozilla's `pdfjs-dist@6.4.299` npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.4.299.tgz

Includes the legacy minified module and worker, CMaps, standard fonts, and WASM
decoders. All assets are bundled for offline use. No runtime CDN requests.
Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
License: Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE and asset-specific licenses in subdirectories).

The text-layer styles in reader-pdf.css follow the matching upstream text layer.
